end.summary: Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere with guided practice.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised naming 3D shapes and matching objects such as a belan, toilet roll, dice, matchbox and football. They explained that a cylinder has two flat circular ends and one curved side, and later identified the belan as a cylinder. They mixed up the terms circle and sphere at first, then corrected this during the lesson. At home, ask them to find and name three 3D-shaped objects around the house.
